name: Thorn Tithe
text: +150 ATK against isolated enemies; the Coven takes what stands alone.

name: Creeping Briar
text: The platoon roots in place: +100 DEF until the end of the round.

name: Host Aloft
text: Angelic allies within 2 hexes gain +100 DEF while this unit is airborne.

name: Choir Ascendant
text: The choir rises: the platoon gains +2 MOV and ignores ground terrain costs this round.

name: Grounding Rod
text: +150 DEF against ritualists and casters; the clan earths hostile magic.

name: Stormfront
text: Call the front: 400 damage to one enemy within 4, arcing to 2 further enemies within 2 of the last.

name: Still Mind
text: Monks cannot be Suppressed or Silenced; the breath continues regardless.

name: Unbroken Form
text: The order sets its stance: +150 DEF and immunity to forced movement this round.

name: Two Traditions
text: Fusion units adjacent to another fusion unit gain +100 ATK: two schools, one line.

name: Iron Stance
text: +100 DEF against frontal attacks.

name: Drawn Arc
text: After moving at least 2 hexes, the next melee attack gains +250 ATK.

name: Banner Call
text: Rally the platoon.

name: Second Cut
text: When attacked in melee and not defeated, strike back at 60% ATK once per round.

name: Shadowstep
text: Move up to 3 hexes ignoring zone of control, then become Hidden.

name: Poisoned Edge
text: Wounds inflicted by this unit deal a further 150 damage at the end of each of the next 2 rounds.

name: False Trail
text: Leave one decoy for two rounds; it has 30% ATK, 1 HP, and cannot capture.

name: Throat of Night
text: +250 ATK against an enemy with no adjacent allies.

name: Shield Line
text: +150 DEF while adjacent to another Knight.

name: Interpose
text: Once per round, take a melee hit aimed at an adjacent ally.

name: Couched Lance
text: Charge 3+ hexes for +350 ATK; the rider is Exposed until its next activation.

name: Oathlight
text: Allies within 2 hexes gain +75 DEF.

name: Wingwash
text: Adjacent enemies lose 10 morale.

name: Scaled Hide
text: Reduce all incoming damage by 150, to a minimum of the floor.

name: Stoop
text: Dive from altitude: +400 ATK after moving 4 or more hexes.

name: Kindled Breath
text: Breathe along a two-hex cone for 500 damage.

name: Briar Snare
text: One enemy within 3 cannot move on its next activation.

name: Blood Loam
text: Recover 25% of damage dealt as hit points.

name: Hex Sign
text: One enemy within 3 becomes Exposed for 2 rounds.

name: Thornward
text: Melee attackers take 200 damage.

name: Winged Guard
text: +150 DEF against ranged attacks while airborne.

name: Herald's Cry
text: Adjacent enemies lose 15 morale and cannot Rally next round.

name: Mending Light
text: Restore 500 hit points to one ally within 2.

name: Smite
text: Strike one enemy within 3 for 600 damage that ignores terrain cover.

name: Cleansing Chord
text: Remove all negative statuses from allies within 2.

name: Arc Strike
text: 350 damage to one enemy within 3, arcing to one further enemy within 2.

name: Static Field
text: Melee attackers take 150 damage from discharged charge.

name: Thunderstep
text: Discharge and reform up to 4 hexes away, ignoring zone of control.

name: Stormbond
text: Storm allies within 2 hexes gain +75 ATK.

name: Skyfall Rod
text: Call a bolt onto one enemy within 4 for 550 damage.

name: Open Palm
text: Push an adjacent enemy 2 hexes and deal 250 damage.

name: Breath Count
text: Recover 200 hit points at the end of each round while not adjacent to an enemy.

name: Flowing Guard
text: When attacked in melee, strike back at 50% ATK once per round.

name: Stillpoint
text: Take the stillpoint stance: +400 DEF until the start of the next activation.

name: Mantra of Holding
text: Allies in command radius cannot become Routed this round.

name: Lesser Circle
text: Channel into an adjacent ritual circle.

name: Anchor Stake
text: Open a reinforcement portal with capacity 2.

name: Borrowed Tongue
text: +200 ATK against ritualists and portal keepers.

name: Two Schools
text: Adjacent allies gain +100 ATK; the fused form teaches while it fights.

name: Bridged Form
text: Hold both stances at once: +300 DEF for one round.

name: Sundering Oath
text: Speak the oath that ends houses: 1600 damage to one enemy within 2, ignoring Fortification.

name: Ten Thousand Cuts
text: One draw, three hexes, nine hundred damage along the line.

name: Moonless Verdict
text: 1200 damage to one enemy within 2; an enemy already below 40% hit points is removed outright.

name: Hundred Shadows
text: Four shadows for three rounds at 60% ATK; they cannot capture and grant no cohesion.

name: Unbreakable Dawn
text: The wall holds: this unit and allies within 2 gain +900 DEF for two rounds.

name: Lance of the Last King
text: Charge three hexes or more for +1500 ATK; the impact pushes survivors one hex.

name: Garden of Knives
text: Briars erupt for two rounds: any enemy that attacks or ends its move within 2 takes 700 damage.

name: Root of the World
text: Every enemy within 3 is rooted for two rounds and loses 20 morale.

name: Skybreaker
text: A four-hex breath of split air for 1400 damage; flying targets take a further 300.

name: Territorial Edict
text: For two rounds no enemy may fly within 5 hexes, and enemies below take −200 DEF.

name: Wyrmfire Judgement
text: 1800 damage to one enemy within 4; if it is defeated, every enemy within 2 loses 25 morale.

name: The Long Invitation
text: Open a portal of capacity five that costs no Reserve Points this round.

name: Six Wings, One Voice
text: 1500 damage to every enemy within 3; survivors are Exposed and cannot use Reactions next round.

name: Wheels Within Wheels
text: The wheels turn: move up to 8 hexes ignoring everything, and one ally within 3 moves with you.

name: Throne of Judgement
text: 1200 damage and −30 morale to every enemy within 4; allies within 4 are Cleansed.

name: Herald of the Last Hour
text: Return two fallen allies at 50% hit points adjacent to this unit.

name: Eyes of the Inner Ring
text: Nothing is Hidden for two rounds and allies gain +150 ATK against revealed targets.

name: First Strike of the Storm
text: 1300 damage to one enemy within 5, arcing to four further enemies at no falloff.

name: The Sky Answers
text: A standing column of lightning: 1000 damage in a 3-hex radius, repeating at the end of the round.

name: Empty Hand, Empty World
text: 1400 damage to one adjacent enemy; below half hit points it is simply stopped.

name: The Unmoved
text: +1200 DEF for three rounds; this unit cannot be moved, rooted, pushed or routed.

name: Two Blades, One Breath
text: Three strikes at 70% ATK, each able to choose a different adjacent target.

name: Silent Temple
text: Every enemy within 3 is Silenced for two rounds; rituals in the area lose all progress.

name: Dragon and Crown
text: The wyrm and the rider strike as one: 1100 damage within 2, and the pair gains +400 DEF for a round.

name: Stormclad Host
text: For two rounds allies within 3 gain +400 ATK and their attacks arc to a second target.

name: Thorned Ascent
text: For two rounds this unit heals for the full damage it deals and cannot be healed by anything else.
